cross_group_duplicates.note: Keep both: a decision and its enforcement. N21c-35 is the one home of the record registries/compute_envelope.toml (states, per-run E3 approvals, lint), the decision packet with per-package requests and fallbacks, and the default E0 as a fact. N36-20 is the one home of enforcement: demand vector, device-hour meter, the admission function with its timeout, the Admitted token, the out-of-process hook, KA-823. Duplicated in both: the needed-class function (two frob-core modules, compute_envelope and envelope, each with its own case table), the tests of the 761 refusal, the point-against-upper-end control, the not-run reason, and one e2e script each (open_spark_2.sh, perf_envelope_meter.sh). N36-20 has what N21c-35 lacks: consumption so far per scope inside the class computation, the reading that E2 and E3 inherit E1's per-run limits, the 24-thread and 20 GiB cases, the refusal payload with the split repair, the timeout rule, the whole KA-823 arithmetic. N21c-35 has what N36-20 lacks: the registry schema and lint, the FROB-REF-704 campaign case, the train.start path in its script, outcome handling. Suggested: one function needed_class(demand, consumed, registry) in one module, built in N36-20 (it needs the meter) on the record N21c-35 defines; N21c-35's acceptance lines 2, 3 and 5 cite N36-20's tests. N36-20 depends on N21c-35 (recorded)

Keep both; one part is duplicated. N36-05 (M0) is the one home of the bound 1/(1 − f + f/r + h), min_fraction_for, the family-batch bound, the three usage rules, the record frob.perf.ceiling/1 with before-experiment order checked from the ledger, and the raising function of FROB-REF-866. N21a-27 (M2) keeps profiling mode, the phase ledger, shares, derived figures, frob.stepprofile/1 and the two doctrine thresholds (50% and 15%). Step 3 of its screen recomputes the same ceiling, raises 866 itself and repeats N36-05's known answers (13.5, 6.7, 0.92, 842.8 ÷ 575.7 = 1.46) and the pruning control (20, not 50); it should call ceiling() and admit_experiment() and file a ceiling record (edge recorded). N21a-27 has what N36-05 lacks: refusal of a request with no profile or with a profile whose fingerprint is not the machine's, the candidate's transfer and synchronization cost charged before the 15% test, and KA-549 (the specialization ceiling).
